title: singular Operator Failure v0
description: The machine-readable recovery contract: one stable code, one phase, one bounded next action. Emitted on stdout by preflight/setup commands run with --json when they refuse to continue, and persisted as the last outcome under .singular-state/setup/. `safeToActuate` is always false here — a command that failed cannot have proved the repository safe to run. The human-readable block and this object must name the SAME primary failure.

code.description: Stable diagnosis code, e.g. SINGULAR_ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED. Deliberately NOT an enum: codes are additive, and a consumer pinned to an older bundle must still be able to validate a report carrying a code it has never seen.

phase.description: The step that refused, e.g. engine-resolution, gate-verification, doctor.

state.description: Highest state truthfully reached before the failure ('blocked' when nothing was reached). Never a state the run only intended to reach.

cause.description: Free-form structured detail about this specific failure. Shape varies by code; readers must treat unknown keys as informational.
